meta.title: feat: implement slot-level caching system with per-person storage
meta.body_summary: Implement slot-level caching with per-person storage to speed up slot generation and reduce calendar API calls for individual and team events.

perf_labels.notes: Devin implemented slot caching with database migration; multiple reviews on naming and type safety, but PR stalled and auto-closed after 7 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 537 changed lines across 10 files, this is a medium-sized feature change. As a performance caching PR it was closed without merge — change scale was not the issue, but review feedback was not fully resolved before inactivity auto-close.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers flagged snake_case table naming, use of 'any' types, type casting smells, and requested findUnique over findFirst for performance.
review_details.performance_claim: Slots are cached per user to reduce calendar API calls and improve response times.
review_details.rejection_signals: Auto-closed by Devin bot due to 7+ days inactivity; no CHANGES_REQUESTED or explicit maintainer rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent responded to some feedback with commits fixing naming and types, but could not fully address all concerns; maintainer attention waned and PR auto-closed.

detection_detail.code_reading: zomars and keithwillcode performed inline code review focusing on naming conventions, type safety, and database query optimization; no CI or profiler evidence used.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or reproducible performance test; only narrative claims about caching benefits.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge despite some incremental fixes; remaining issues and inactivity led to bot closure.

core_change_summary.description: Added SlotCache model and repository with per-person caching in Prisma schema; implemented slot caching logic in a new slot-cache module and integrated into getAvailableSlots in util.ts; added invalidation on event type update and Google Calendar webhook.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Migrations and invalidation points are secondary; the core change is the cache module and slot generation refactor.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: full feature with SlotCache model, cache repository, slot generation changes, and invalidation points.
Fix commit: rename table to PascalCase per keithwillcode's feedback.
Second fix commit: switch to findUnique, replace 'any' types, and improve type safety per zomars' feedback.

review_signals.summary: Requested camelCase/PascalCase for table name instead of snake_case.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin renamed table to PascalCase in next commit.

review_signals.summary: Flagged usage of 'any' types in slot generation and requested proper types.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin replaced any with proper slot types in follow-up commits.

review_signals.summary: Requested using findUnique instead of findFirst for cache lookup performance.
Inquired about compound unique index performance.
Bot notification of automatic comment handling for 'DevinAI' prefix.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with full cache implementation.
Multiple inline reviews from keithwillcode, zomars, emrysal within first ~30 minutes focusing on naming, types, and query optimization.
Devin added commits fixing table name and type safety/query performance.
No further maintainer engagement; Devin bot auto-closed after 7+ days of inactivity.
